import face_recognition
import cv2

imageFR = face_recognition.load_image_file("/kaggle/input/datasets/gerardescuderobakx/detecciocares/amics-de-les-arts.jpg")

face_locations = face_recognition.face_locations(imageFR, number_of_times_to_upsample=0, model="cnn")

f"I found {len(face_locations)} face(s) in this photograph."
